name: Dremel
summary: US power-tool brand whose DigiLab 3D-printer line is supported by a filament accessory range on 0.75 kg RFID-tagged spools: PLA, Matte, Silk and Eco PLA, Translucent PETG and TPU. A retailer listing gives China as country of origin; no extruder is named.

oem_relationships.notes: Dremel is a tool/printer brand, and a Zoro listing (PLA-BLU-01) gives country of origin China; no maker is named anywhere. Evidence is origin-only and weak.

product_lines.name: DigiLab PLA
product_lines.notes: 0.75 kg spools with RFID tag read by DigiLab printers for settings; plant-based PLA.

product_lines.name: DF line
product_lines.notes: A 'DF' line is mentioned but its chemistry is not described in the notes.

additional_notes: Sold via Lowe's, Zoro and CDW. Bosch group ownership is general knowledge not verified in this research pass, so no parent-company relationship is encoded. Premium per-kg pricing is suggested but unverified. A guessed Dremel product URL returned 404.

provenance.conflicts: Notes rate confidence low-medium. China origin rests on one retailer listing; HQ city and corporate parent unverified; no Dremel first-party filament page was read.
